Questions? Illuminated.

Everything you need to know before booking your lighting rental.

Yes. We offer delivery and setup in Windhoek for an additional fee. Pickup is free. For locations outside Windhoek, the client is responsible for arranging transport.

Delivery and setup are quoted according to the location and size of the setup required.

Bookings can be made up to 3 months in advance.

There is no maximum rental period. Rental pricing is charged per day.

No. Clients are responsible for providing the required power supply. We do not provide power services.

Yes. Extension cords are available to rent at an additional cost.

Yes. Customer pickup is available free of charge.

The customer is liable for the cost of repairing or replacing any equipment that is damaged or lost during the rental.

We currently accept cash and EFT payments.

Our cancellation and refund policy is outlined in our Terms and Conditions. Custom setups are absolutely possible-contact us with your event requirements and we'll put together a suitable option.

OUR EQUIPMENT

Lighting and effects

We have a range of lighting and effects equipment available, with more gear than shown here. Get in touch and we’ll help you choose the right setup for your event.

6×10W RGBW LED + Laser Bee Eye

Moving effects and laser-style beams for energetic event lighting.

7×10W RGBW Moving Head

Compact moving-head lighting for dance floors and event spaces.

15W UV Bar

UV lighting for glow effects and themed parties.

24 LED RGB Strobe

RGB strobe effects for lively dance floors.

36 LED Par Can

Colour washes for stages, walls and event areas.

36 LED Slim Par Can

A slim profile light for colourful event ambience.

900W Smoke Machine

Adds atmosphere so lighting beams and effects stand out.

BlueGlow LED Tube (95 cm)

A blue glow tube for accent lighting and decorative setups.
